summary.ja_easy: {電気|でんき}の{会社|かいしゃ}は{家|いえ}によって{違|ちが}います。{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に、{不動産|ふどうさん}の{会社|かいしゃ}に{聞|き}きます。ブレーカーのはがきで{申|もう}し{込|こ}むこともあります（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。{出|で}るときは、やめる{日|ひ}を{知|し}らせます（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。
summary.en: Who supplies electricity depends on the home and the contract. Before moving in, ask the real estate agent whom to contact. Some homes have a postcard on the breaker to apply (general explanation; to be confirmed). When you move out, tell the company you contract with the day you stop (to be confirmed).

lead.en: Apply to the electricity company you contract with. Ask the real estate agent whom to contact.

text.en: The real estate agent (ask whom to contact for electricity, gas and water)

evidence.quote: Ask the real estate agent whom to contact for each of the above services.

text.en: Electricity: write your name, address and start date on the postcard attached to the breaker and mail it (general guidance; ask the agent about the Nagoya power company; to be checked).

evidence.quote: To apply for electricity, write your name, address, and usage start date on the postcard attached to the breaker and mail it in.
Ask the real estate agent whom to contact for each of the above services.
